title: Chiller Cooling Circuit Flow Depletion & Isolation Valve V-CH-04 Clearance

steps.instruction: Verify auxiliary chiller jacket supply flow rate Cooling_Water_Flow_PV is strictly greater than 35.0 L/min.
If chiller flow is depleted or zero, visually inspect manual butterfly isolation valve V-CH-04 at chiller heat exchanger return.
Open butterfly valve V-CH-04 to 100% full flow position and verify mechanical locking pin engagement.
Verify cooling interlock Cooling_Interlock_Status resets to 1 (ARMED) and return temperature Chiller_Return_Temp_PV drops below 22.0°C.
Confirm process heat exchanger cooling restored and all downstream reactor vessel thermal warnings extinguish.

title: Buffer Vessel Tank 101 Exothermic Thermal Runaway & Overpressurization Mitigation

steps.instruction: Open headspace vapor vent valve V-101 to relieve vessel pressure below 4.5 bar into secondary scrubber.
Command reactant feed shutoff valve Tank101_Inlet_Valve_Cmd to 0 (CLOSED) to stop mass chemical addition.
Activate emergency jacket deluge cooling and engage recirculation pump at minimum 25% flow.
Ramp agitator speed Tank101_Agitator_Speed_PV to 280 RPM to eliminate localized boundary-layer hot spots.
Verify reactor core temperature Tank101_Temp_PV stabilizes safely below 65.0°C and pressure settles to 2.2 bar.

title: Conveyor 201 Optical Jam Clearance & Altivar VFD Fault Clearance

steps.instruction: Depress Conveyor 201 Stop button or local E-Stop to de-energize motor stator and prevent belt surface friction burns.
Inspect optical sensor CV201_Jam_Detect_PE1 at infeed guide rails for wedged product containers, damaged cartons, or reflective lens dust.
Perform zero-energy mechanical clearance of trapped items complying with LOTO safety protocols.
Verify drive motor phase current CV201_Motor_Current has settled below 16.5A before releasing drive restart command.
Clear inverter diagnostic register CV201_VFD_Fault_Code (Fault 402) from the EcoStruxure HMI drive diagnostics page.

title: Control Network & Power Bus Transients Recovery

steps.instruction: Verify 24VDC auxiliary switchboard power supply bus status and check Modicon M580 rack power indicator.
Inspect Modbus TCP / Ethernet/IP switch link lights on local industrial managed switch.
Once root power or network failure is rectified, perform collective alarm acknowledge from HMI Master Screen.

title: Master Emergency Stop Circuit Tripping & Pneumatic Pressure Recovery

steps.instruction: Visually verify that all personnel are clear of conveyor transfer points and rotating machinery.
Check auxiliary pneumatic compressor K-02 and verify header pressure Air_Pressure_Supply_PV > 6.0 bar.
Rotate and release all physical mushroom Emergency Stop pushbuttons on Line 01 (PB1 and PB2).
Depress the Master Safety Reset blue pushbutton on main control cabinet door for 2.0 seconds to reset safety permissive.
Verify dual-channel safety relay Line01_EStop_Relay_Status channel A/B LED indicators illuminate solid green.

title: Industrial Chiller Pump Impeller Cavitation & Secondary Heat Exchanger Cascade Recovery (ASHRAE 15 / ISO 5149)

steps.instruction: Immediately verify suction pressure HX_Suction_Pressure_PV. If pressure < 0.6 bar or pump vibration HX_Pump101_Vibration_PV > 4.5 mm/s, pump cavitation is occurring.
Initiate automated or manual lead-to-lag pump failover by commanding HX_Standby_Pump_Cmd = 1 to start standby auxiliary chiller pump P-102.
Verify cooling loop flow rate HX_Pump101_Flow_PV and Cooling_Water_Flow_PV recover above 42.0 L/min within 15 seconds.
Confirm downstream thermal cooling interlock Cooling_Interlock_Status resets to 1 (ARMED), cooling Tank 101 core temperature below 65.0°C and extinguishing secondary cascade alarms.
Perform zero-energy Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) on pump P-101 suction line and inspect Y-strainer mesh for particulate fouling or scaling before re-commissioning.
